MISSING_TERMS:
- Collateral covenant specifics: borrower must notify the lender upon acquisition of any material assets after the Effective Date; upon lender request, cause such assets (excluding real property or assets that automatically become collateral under the Security Agreement) to be subjected to a lien securing the Secured Obligations; and take all actions necessary or reasonably requested (including those in Section 5.14(c)) to grant and perfect such liens at the loan parties’ expense, all subject to the Intercreditor Agreement.
